name: Trade Surveillance Agent
description: Analyse trading activity to detect patterns indicative of market abuse — including layering, spoofing, wash trading, and front-running. ClickHouse captures large volumes of order and trade events, enabling AI agents to investigate anomalies, compare behaviours, and surface alerts with supporting context.
longDescription: Detect and investigate market abuse patterns across order and trade data at sub-second granularity. ClickHouse processes millions of order events enabling AI agents to perform layering detection, spoofing analysis, and wash trade identification — correlating order placement, cancellation sequences, and execution outcomes across instruments and desks. Agents contextualise anomalies against peer trader behaviour, surface watchlist hits, and generate structured alert narratives that meet MAR and FCA notification requirements, dramatically reducing manual triage burden on compliance teams.
schema:
-- Trade Surveillance Schema
CREATE TABLE trades (
    trade_id       UInt64,
    instrument_id  String,
    trader_id      String,
    desk           String,
    side           Enum8('BUY'=1, 'SELL'=2),
    quantity       Float64,
    price          Float64,
    notional       Float64,
    venue          String,
    trade_time     DateTime64(3),
    order_id       UInt64
) ENGINE = MergeTree()
ORDER BY (trade_time, instrument_id);

CREATE TABLE orders (
    order_id       UInt64,
    instrument_id  String,
    trader_id      String,
    side           Enum8('BUY'=1, 'SELL'=2),
    order_type     Enum8('LIMIT'=1, 'MARKET'=2, 'STOP'=3),
    quantity       Float64,
    price          Float64,
    status         Enum8('NEW'=1, 'PARTIAL'=2, 'FILLED'=3, 'CANCELLED'=4),
    submit_time    DateTime64(3),
    cancel_time    Nullable(DateTime64(3))
) ENGINE = MergeTree()
ORDER BY (submit_time, instrument_id);

CREATE TABLE surveillance_alerts (
    alert_id       UUID,
    alert_type     String,
    trader_id      String,
    instrument_id  String,
    severity       Enum8('LOW'=1, 'MEDIUM'=2, 'HIGH'=3, 'CRITICAL'=4),
    score          Float32,
    detected_at    DateTime64(3),
    description    String,
    status         Enum8('OPEN'=1, 'UNDER_REVIEW'=2, 'CLOSED'=3)
) ENGINE = MergeTree()
ORDER BY (detected_at, severity);

CREATE TABLE watchlist (
    trader_id      String,
    instrument_id  String,
    reason         String,
    added_date     Date,
    added_by       String,
    active         UInt8
) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree()
ORDER BY (trader_id, instrument_id);

name: Best Execution Agent
description: Analyse execution quality across brokers, venues, and order types to understand where slippage, spread capture, and fill performance vary. ClickHouse gives AI agents a large execution history to query so they can compare routing decisions and investigate where trading outcomes diverge from expectation.
longDescription: Analyse post-trade execution quality across brokers, venues, order types, and market conditions to demonstrate MiFID II best execution compliance. ClickHouse aggregates tick-level execution data at scale, enabling AI agents to decompose slippage into market impact, timing cost, and spread components — comparing fill rates and arrival price deviations across venues by instrument and order size. Agents identify systematic routing inefficiencies, surface underperforming venues, and generate the quantitative evidence needed for best execution policy reviews and client reporting.

name: Fraud Detection Agent
description: Analyse card and digital payment activity in ClickHouse by querying historical behavioural patterns. AI agents investigate velocity, geography, merchant category, and device fingerprints together to prioritise suspicious transactions and explain why they stand out.
longDescription: Investigate transaction-level fraud signals across card payments, digital channels, and customer behaviour patterns using high-velocity event data. ClickHouse's columnar compression enables millisecond aggregation across hundreds of millions of transactions, giving AI agents the context to score anomalies, link device fingerprints, and surface emerging fraud typologies in real time. Agents triage alert queues by expected loss value, identify account takeover sequences, and build fraud ring hypotheses by connecting shared attributes across compromised accounts — reducing false positive rates and accelerating case closure.

    txn_id          UInt64,
    customer_id     UInt64,
    card_id         String,
    amount          Float64,
    currency        FixedString(3),
    merchant_id     String,

ORDER BY (customer_id, txn_time);

CREATE TABLE fraud_scores (
    txn_id          UInt64,
    customer_id     UInt64,
    score           Float32,
    model_version   String,
    velocity_flag   UInt8,
    geo_flag        UInt8,
    device_flag     UInt8,

CREATE TABLE fraud_cases (
    case_id         UUID,
    customer_id     UInt64,
    txn_id          UInt64,
    case_type       String,
    confirmed_fraud UInt8,
    loss_amount     Float64,
    recovered       Float64,
    opened_at       Date,

CREATE TABLE customer_profiles (

    home_country    FixedString(2),

    usual_merchants Array(String),
    devices         Array(String),
    risk_tier       Enum8('LOW'=1,'MEDIUM'=2,'HIGH'=3),

) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(profile_date)
ORDER BY customer_id;

name: Deposit Attrition Agent
description: Analyse customer balance movements, product mix, and engagement patterns to investigate attrition risk and funding concentration. ClickHouse lets AI agents query account behaviour across large customer populations and explain which segments appear most vulnerable.
longDescription: Track deposit balance migration, rate sensitivity, and attrition signals across the retail book to support liability management and retention strategy. ClickHouse enables AI agents to identify cohorts showing early runoff behaviour, model elasticity to competitor rate changes, and segment customers by product tenure, balance tier, and digital engagement. Agents surface at-risk segments weeks before attrition crystallises, connect deposit behaviour to broader relationship profitability, and recommend targeted intervention triggers for front-line teams.

name: Performance Attribution Agent

ClickHouse stores billions of daily NAV snapshots and position records, enabling AI agents to explore attribution across any time window or fund hierarchy.

Agents generate client-ready attribution narratives, flag persistent misalignment between stated investment process and actual portfolio behaviour, and support GIPS-compliant reporting workflows.

    security_id      String,

    as_of_date       Date

    fund_id          String,
    investor_id      String,
    channel          String,
    holding_value    Float64,
    pct_of_fund      Float32,
    as_of_date       Date
) ENGINE = MergeTree()
ORDER BY (as_of_date, fund_id, investor_id);

longDescription: Investigate patient safety incidents across a hospital trust by combining incident reports, medication and falls detail, contributory factor investigations, and ward-level activity at scale. ClickHouse holds every reported event alongside occupied bed days and staffing mix, enabling AI agents to normalise raw incident counts into rates per 1,000 bed days, compare degree of harm across wards and specialties, and isolate where in the medication process errors originate. Agents surface the clusters that warrant a thematic review, quantify where falls assessments are being missed, and test whether staffing pressure tracks with harm.

-- Patient Safety Incident Schema
